def fetch_database(session: requests.Session, full: bool=False, db: Union[
    Optional[str], bool]=False, cached: int=0, telemetry: bool=True,
    ecosystem: Optional[Ecosystem]=None, from_cache: bool=True) ->Dict[str, Any
    ]:
    
    if db:
        mirrors = [db]
    else:
        mirrors = API_MIRRORS if not full else OPEN_MIRRORS
        
    db_name = "insecure_full.json" if full else "insecure.json"

    for mirror in mirrors:
        # mirror can either be a local path or a URL
        if is_a_remote_mirror(mirror):
            db_data = fetch_database_url(session, mirror, db_name=db_name, cached=cached,
                                         telemetry=telemetry, ecosystem=ecosystem, from_cache=from_cache)
        else:
            db_data = fetch_database_file(mirror, db_name=db_name, cached=cached, ecosystem=ecosystem)
        if db_data:
            return db_data
            
    raise DatabaseFetchError()
